user.title: Connect Ultimate Updater
user.description: Address of the Ultimate Updater Web UI (5.2 or newer) and an API token of its integration API v1. Create the token on the Proxmox host with `ultimate-updater-api-token create homeassistant --permissions read,logs,check,update,reboot,cancel`.

data_description.host: Host of the Ultimate Updater Web UI (usually a Proxmox node).
data_description.port: Port of the Web UI, 8765 by default. The API works over HTTPS only.
data_description.api_token: Shown only once when it is created. Leave out permissions you do not want to grant.
data_description.validate_certificate: Off by default because the Web UI usually uses the self-signed Proxmox certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {host} was rejected. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Ultimate Updater Web UI.
error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected or lacks the "read" permission.
error.api_error: Ultimate Updater answered with an error. Is version 5.2 or newer installed and the API enabled (`ultimate-updater-api-token enable`)?

abort.already_configured: This Ultimate Updater is already configured.
abort.wrong_instance: This is a different Ultimate Updater. Add it as a new integration instead.

data.poll_busy: Job poll interval while a job is running
data.remove_stale: Remove systems that no longer exist

data_description.status_interval: Interval for reading all systems. After a job has finished the status is read right away.
data_description.exclude_targets: VMs/CTs that the collective update buttons skip (e.g. the Home Assistant VM itself). They can still be updated individually.
data_description.bulk_targets: "All" only works if updating stopped guests is enabled in Ultimate Updater (STOPPED_CONTAINER / STOPPED_VM in update.conf); if Ultimate Updater reports that it is off, shut down guests are skipped anyway. Systems that Ultimate Updater does not update through the API are always skipped.
data_description.allow_reboot: Creates a reboot button per host/VM/CT, usable while it needs a reboot.
data_description.remove_stale: Removes the devices of hosts/VMs/CTs that Ultimate Updater no longer reports.

job_running.message: A check/update job is already running – please wait until it has finished.

bulk_running.message: A collective update is running – please wait or stop it first.

permission_denied.message: The API token lacks the permission for this action: {error}

unknown_target.message: Unknown system {target} – please wait for the next refresh.

reboot_disabled.message: Reboot buttons are disabled in the integration options.

api_unsafe_script_path.message: {target} cannot be updated through the API: Ultimate Updater would run extra, community, helper or custom scripts there (e.g. Pi-hole, Docker Compose, scripts.d), which it never does for API actions. Update it in the Ultimate Updater Web UI, the CLI or its own schedule.

api_preflight_unavailable.message: {target} cannot be updated through the API: Ultimate Updater could not verify that no extra or custom scripts would run (e.g. because it is shut down). Start it, or update it in the Ultimate Updater Web UI, the CLI or its own schedule.

stopped_update_disabled.message: {target} is shut down and Ultimate Updater only updates shut down guests with STOPPED_CONTAINER / STOPPED_VM enabled in its update.conf. Start it first.

backup_required.message: Ultimate Updater did not start the update of {target}: the backup safety requirement of its configuration is not met (API updates never skip it). Create the backup or update it in the Web UI.

reboot_not_required.message: {target} is not marked as needing a reboot – Ultimate Updater only reboots systems that need it. Check it again first.

api_update_blocked.title: Some systems cannot be updated through the API

confirm.title: Systems not updatable through the API ({title})
